say:1:1064402001:0.text: Night descends on Resford. Though the wind still rages outside, the city is bathed in warmth and light. From Lord Sno's castle come the sounds of laughter and clinking glasses.
say:1:1064402001:0.source_cn: 夜幕笼罩北地，风雪呼号。安息城内温暖明亮，领主城堡方向...

say:2:1064402002:0.text: Instead of attending the banquet held in her honor, Alna remains at the city gate, gazing into the darkness beyond the walls. A thin layer of snow settles over her armor.
say:2:1064402002:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜没有参加为她而设的宴会，她立于城门，凝视城外受风...

say:5:1064402003:0.text: General, two more groups of refugees have arrived from the south. According to them, the Hypofiends that destroyed their villages are advancing north.
say:5:1064402003:0.source_cn: 将军，又来了两批南方流民。他们都提到有屠戮村庄的魔物，...

say:6:1064402004:1.text: And we still haven't heard from the scout teams we sent out yesterday. Maybe the blizzard's too severe...
say:6:1064402004:1.source_cn: 另外，昨天派出去的三队斥候，还没有任何音讯。风雪太大了...

say:7:1064402005:1.text:
There may be other factors at play.
Anyway, take the refugees in and help them settle down.
say:7:1064402005:1.source_cn: 也许并非风雪。\n接收流民，按此前的要求安置。

say:8:1064402006:1.text: Double the guard at all city gates. Report any unusual activity at once.
say:8:1064402006:1.source_cn: 向城门加派双倍人手，有任何异动，立刻示警。

say:10:1064402007:0.text: As the blizzard briefly subsides, a hooded figure emerges from the snowy plains, staff in hand.
say:10:1064402007:0.source_cn: 风雪稍歇的间隙，一个戴着兜帽、手持法杖的身影自雪原中出现。

say:13:1064402009:0.text: General, I'm Merlin, a mage from the south. Please inform your ruler that I have important news concerning Resford's survival.
say:13:1064402009:0.source_cn: 将军，我名为梅林，一名自南方而来的魔法师。请代为通报领...

say:14:1064402010:0.text: I understand it's difficult to trust a stranger. You're wondering what became of your scouts, aren't you? I found their bodies in the south.
say:14:1064402010:0.source_cn: 我知晓您此刻心存疑虑，但您派出的斥候，我在南方见到了他...

say:15:1064402011:0.text: If you let me in, I can help you defend Resford against the Hypofiends.
say:15:1064402011:0.source_cn: 让我进城，或许能在灾厄降临前，筑起一线生机。

narration:16:1064402012:0.text: Alna studies the poised figure outside the city for a moment before inviting her into her tent.
narration:16:1064402012:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜审视城外平静的身影，片刻后，她将其带入营帐中

say:18:1064402013:0.text: Thank you for receiving me, General...

say:19:1064402014:1.text: Skip the formalities. Just tell me what you know. If you utter a single lie, you'll be banished.
say:19:1064402014:1.source_cn: 免去客套，直说你知晓的消息。记住，若有半分谎言，你将会...

say:20:1064402015:1.text: A powerful Hypogean has awakened from the abyss. It has rallied a vast army of Hypofiends and is now advancing north from the south.
say:20:1064402015:1.source_cn: 源于深渊的意志已然苏醒，恶魔正驱策魔物大军，自南方向北席卷。

say:21:1064402016:1.text: Neither mortal weapons nor the bitter cold can stop them. Wherever they pass, they leave nothing behind but death and ruin.
say:21:1064402016:1.source_cn: 它们不惧凡人的武器，不畏北地严寒，所过之处，生灵涂炭。

say:22:1064402017:0.text:
Why should I trust you?
You're a complete stranger, showing up right as my city faces a crisis.
say:22:1064402017:0.source_cn: 我为何要相信你？\n一个来历不明，在我军情紧急之时，突...

say:24:1064402018:0.text: In response, Merlin begins chanting a spell. A vision unfolds before everyone, revealing hideous Hypofiends tearing humans apart as cries of despair echo in every direction.
say:24:1064402018:0.source_cn: 梅林吟咏咒语，浮现出魔法影像：样貌扭曲的魔物轻易撕开人...

say:25:1064402019:1.text: The towers of Castleville collapse into ruins beneath torrents of fire. Dried blood blankets the streets of Macyland, and the bodies of Resford's scouts lie scattered across Buckham.
say:25:1064402019:1.source_cn: 卡索城的塔楼在魔物喷出的火焰中化为残垣，梅卡镇尽是冻结...

say:26:1064402020:0.text: Even Alna, a battlefield veteran, is shaken by the horrifying sight.
say:26:1064402020:0.source_cn: 纵然阿尔娜饱经沙场，但那些扭曲的形态与纯粹的恶意，让她...

say:28:1064402021:0.text: Resford is a thriving commercial hub with immense wealth, making it too tempting a target for the Hypofiends to ignore.
say:28:1064402021:0.source_cn: 安息城，北地富饶的商陆核心，堆积如山的财富，对渴求掠夺...

say:29:1064402022:0.text: At their current pace, they'll reach your gates in no more than five days.
say:29:1064402022:0.source_cn: 以魔物大军的行进速度，最多五日，便会到达安息城外。

say:30:1064402023:0.text: ... Very well, Merlin. How do you propose to help us?
say:30:1064402023:0.source_cn: ……嗯。那么，梅林，你所说的一线生机是什么？

say:31:1064402024:1.text: Surely you didn't travel all this way just to tell us we're finished.
say:31:1064402024:1.source_cn: 你穿越魔潮来到北地，总不会只是为了告诉我死期将至。

say:32:1064402025:1.text: Merlin produces a fist-sized crystal. The moment it appears, the flames in the furnaces flicker and dim.
say:32:1064402025:1.source_cn: 梅林取出一枚拳头大小的冰晶，它出现的瞬间，火炉中的焰火...

say:33:1064402026:1.text: This is the <style="highlight">Seed of Frost</style>, the last crystallization of the Winter Goddess' divinity before her demise.

say:34:1064402027:1.text: Through <style="highlight">divine resonance</style>, it responds to <style="highlight">glacite</style> and to <style="highlight">those of exceptionally strong will</style>.

say:35:1064402028:1.text: By fusing the Seed of Frost with glacite through magic, we can raise an ice barrier around Resford strong enough to repel the Hypofiend horde.
say:35:1064402028:1.source_cn: 以它为核心，借助魔法融合冰蓝晶，可在安息城外，构筑一道...

say:36:1064402029:0.text: Alna's blood surges, and <style="highlight">for a fleeting moment, she hears something calling out to her.</style>
say:36:1064402029:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜感到血液似乎流动得稍快了一些，<style=hi...

say:38:1064402030:0.text: Dunn, fetch some glacite from the vault.
say:38:1064402030:0.source_cn: 邓恩，去财库，取冰蓝晶来。

say:40:1064402031:0.text: General, glacite is extremely valuable. We'll need a written order from the finance officer to access it...
say:40:1064402031:0.source_cn: 将军，冰蓝晶可是极为珍贵的材料，每一克都登记在册，需要...

say:41:1064402032:0.text: Go ahead and do whatever it takes! If anything goes wrong, I'll take full responsibility.
say:41:1064402032:0.source_cn: 那就去找财政官！所有责任我来承担。

narration:43:1064402033:0.text: A few hours later, Dunn returns with a small amount of glacite dust.
narration:43:1064402033:0.source_cn: 数小时后，邓恩带回少量冰蓝晶粉末

say:44:1064402034:0.text: Show me the barrier here, Merlin. Make it as big as you can.
say:44:1064402034:0.source_cn: 在这里，筑起你能做到的最大屏障，梅林。

say:45:1064402035:0.text: I'll see for myself how strong it really is.
say:45:1064402035:0.source_cn: 我要亲自验证冰封之墙的防御能力。

say:46:1064402036:0.text: Merlin recites another spell, and glacite dust swirls around the glowing Seed of Frost, forming a barrier of ice.
say:46:1064402036:0.source_cn: 梅林再次吟咏咒语，冰蓝晶粉末环绕微亮的寒冰之种，随后洒...

say:51:1064402037:0.text: Alna drives her spear into the ice with all her might, yet fails to leave even a scratch.
say:51:1064402037:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜全力刺向冰层，然而，曾无数次冲破敌阵的力量，甚至...

say:56:1064402039:0.text: Alna charges forward again, but the ice refuses to budge.
say:56:1064402039:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜再次发力，这一次，冰层依然纹丝未动。

say:57:1064402040:1.text: <style="highlight">Then, she hears the voice again. The Seed of Frost seems to resonate with her.</style>

say:58:1064402041:1.text:
...
How much glacite would it take to shield the entire city?
say:58:1064402041:1.source_cn: ……\n构筑足以保护整个安息城的冰封之墙，需要多少冰蓝晶？

say:59:1064402042:1.text: Enough to all but empty your city's coffers. That's why I need an audience with your ruler. Without his support, Resford will suffer the same fate as the cities to the south.
say:59:1064402042:1.source_cn: 足以掏空一个富庶城邦数年的储备，若没有领主的支持，安息...

say:60:1064402043:1.text: Bring the Seed of Frost with you, and follow me into the city.
say:60:1064402043:1.source_cn: 带上寒冰之种，随我入城。
